description: This file is a C header file defining function prototypes related to managing 'dm' context and objects, likely in a device management system. It also includes licensing information and author credits.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes a device management context with a given entry object.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_clean
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with a device management context.

methods.name: bbf_ctx_init_sub
methods.description: Performs sub-context initialization for device management.

methods.name: bbf_fault_map
methods.description: Maps or handles faults within the device management context.

methods.name: bbf_entry_method
methods.description: Executes an operation command on the device management context.

methods.name: bbf_global_init
methods.description: Performs global initialization for device management entry.

methods.name: bbf_global_clean
methods.description: Performs cleanup of global resources related to device management.

methods.name: dm_validate_allowed_objects
methods.description: Validates a list of objects against the device management context.

methods.name: adm_entry_object_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry object exists in the context (marked for removal).

methods.name: bbf_entry_services
methods.description: Provides services related to the specified protocol and operation flags.
